Explore

Every one of the 361 records in the catalog, grouped by domain. For filtered and ranked results use search; this page is the complete browsable index.

0 of 361 records have been independently verified (tier 2 or above). The rest carry metadata imported from the original lists and marked not confirmed where it was never recorded. That is the honest state of the catalog today, and the methodology explains how a record moves up a tier.

Bioengineering (70)

  • BasicoSimple Python API over COPASI so its solvers are scriptable in a notebook
  • Benchling (free academic tier)Cloud molecular biology suite: sequence design, cloning simulation, and an ELN. Free for academic labs
  • Benchling alternatives — pydnaSimulates cloning, Gibson assembly, and PCR in code so a construction plan is reproducible and diffable
  • BiGG ModelsCurated repository of high-quality genome-scale models with standardised identifiers and an API
  • BiocondaConda channel with 8000+ bioinformatics packages; makes reproducible bio environments tractable
  • BioconductorThe R ecosystem for omics analysis, with rigorous package review and vignettes
  • Bioengineering Stack ExchangeNearest Q&A site for computational bio questions, with knowledgeable answerers
  • BioModelsRepository of curated, annotated published models you can load and rerun
  • BioNetGenRule-based modelling for systems with combinatorial complexity — receptor states, phosphorylation cascades — where writing every species is hopeless
  • BiopythonSequence handling, file parsing, and interfaces to the major biological databases
  • BioSTEAMFast techno-economic analysis and process simulation for biorefineries, with unit operations, costing, and uncertainty propagation built in
  • BRENDAThe comprehensive enzyme kinetics database: kcat, Km, inhibitors, and conditions, extracted from the literature
  • Build-A-Cell open community resourcesMaterials and talks from the synthetic cell community, useful for bottom-up bioengineering
  • CarveMeTop-down reconstruction that carves a species model out of a universal model in seconds, well suited to hundreds of genomes
  • Catalyst.jlDomain-specific language for reaction networks in Julia that compiles to ODE, SDE, or jump-process models
  • CelloCompiles Verilog descriptions of logic into genetic circuits with characterised gates; the clearest demonstration of design automation for biology
  • CellProfilerPipeline-based quantitative image analysis for high-content screening, no coding required
  • ChasteCambridge's simulation library for cardiac electrophysiology and cell-based tissue models, with strong testing culture
  • COBRA ToolboxThe MATLAB counterpart, with a much larger set of specialised methods including thermodynamic and expression-integrated analyses
  • COBRApyConstraint-based reconstruction and analysis in Python: FBA, pFBA, FVA, gene deletions, and model editing. The default entry point
  • COBRApy documentation tutorialsWorked from a first FBA to gene-deletion screens; do these before reading papers
  • cobrapy sampling — OptGPSamplerUniform flux sampling for when a single FBA optimum isn't a defensible answer
  • ColabFoldAlphaFold2 and related models made runnable in a notebook in minutes rather than a cluster in days
  • COMBINEThe standards community behind SBML, SBOL, and SED-ML; annual meetings and open working groups
  • CompuCell3DMulti-cell modelling environment (cellular Potts) for morphogenesis, cell sorting, and tissue growth
  • COPASIBiochemical network simulator with steady-state, time-course, stochastic, and parameter-estimation methods behind a usable GUI
  • DNA ChiselSequence optimisation under constraints: codon usage, restriction sites, GC content, synthesis manufacturability
  • Edinburgh Genome Foundry toolsetA dozen focused libraries for assembly planning, primer design, sequence validation, and lab report generation
  • ESBES — European Society of Biochemical Engineering SciencesBioprocess engineering across Europe, with an active early-career section
  • ESM / ESMFoldProtein language models for embeddings, variant effect prediction, and single-sequence structure prediction
  • ETFL / thermodynamic FBA (pytfa)Adds thermodynamic constraints and expression-and-allocation constraints so flux solutions are physically reachable
  • FAIRDOMHubData, model, and SOP management for systems biology projects, built around FAIR principles
  • FEBioFinite element solver purpose-built for biological materials: hyperelasticity, poroelasticity, growth and remodelling
  • Fiji / ImageJImage analysis for histology, live-cell imaging, and scaffold characterisation, with a plugin for nearly everything
  • FoldX alternatives — FoldSeekStructure search across the whole AlphaFold database in seconds, for finding remote structural homologues
  • GalaxyWeb platform for running and sharing analyses with full provenance, usable without a terminal
  • GibbonMATLAB toolbox for computational biomechanics: meshing, FEBio interfacing, and image-based model generation
  • iGEM CompetitionAnnual student synthetic biology competition; the parts, wikis, and safety guidance are all public
  • iGEM Registry of Standard Biological PartsThe community parts registry, with characterisation data of variable but often useful quality
  • iGEM team wiki archiveTwo decades of team wikis: a large, uneven, and genuinely useful record of what synthetic biology projects actually attempted
  • libRoadRunnerHigh-performance SBML simulation engine with JIT compilation; what you use when a parameter sweep needs a million integrations
  • Materials Project — biocompatible alloys subsetComputed properties for the metals and ceramics used in implants, with an open API
  • MemoteStandardised test suite that scores a metabolic model's quality — mass balance, annotation coverage, consistency — and produces a report you can put in a paper
  • Metabolic Engineering (International Metabolic Engineering Society)Biennial meeting, the reference venue for strain engineering
  • MICOMCommunity-level metabolic modelling for microbiomes, with trade-offs between community and individual growth
  • MIRIAM & MIASE guidelinesMinimum information standards for annotating and simulating models, from the COMBINE community
  • MIT 20.320 Analysis of Biomolecular and Cellular Systems (OCW)Quantitative modelling of receptor binding, signalling, and pharmacokinetics
  • ModelSEED / KBaseAutomated draft reconstruction from an annotated genome, with gap-filling and a hosted environment for the whole pipeline
  • nf-coreCommunity-curated, peer-reviewed Nextflow pipelines with consistent structure and testing
  • OpenFOAMGeneral CFD; the mixer and multiphase tutorials are the usual starting point for stirred-tank mixing time and shear studies. No bioreactor-specific case ships with it
  • OptKnock / OptFlux strain designComputational strain design (OptKnock, OptGene) with a GUI, aimed at metabolic engineers rather than programmers
  • PhysiCellAgent-based simulator for multicellular systems with diffusive substrates; scales to millions of cells
  • PolyInfo / Polymer Genome open subsetsProperty data and ML predictions for polymers, including degradation and mechanical properties relevant to implants
  • ProteinMPNNInverse folding: given a backbone, propose sequences that fold to it, with high experimental success rates
  • protocols.ioVersioned, citable experimental protocols; the fix for "as previously described"
  • PyFOOMBObject-oriented bioprocess modelling with parameter estimation, uncertainty quantification, and support for multi-experiment fitting
  • PyRosettaPython bindings to Rosetta for scripted design protocols
  • Ribosome binding site calculator (open reimplementations)Thermodynamic prediction of translation initiation rate for RBS design
  • Rosetta Commons (free academic licence)The reference suite for protein design, docking, and structure prediction; free to academics
  • SBMLThe systems biology markup language; if a model can't be exported to SBML, it can't easily be reused
  • SBOL — Synthetic Biology Open LanguageData standard for genetic designs, with and implementations; the interchange format between design tools
  • scikit-bioCore data structures and algorithms for sequences, alignments, and diversity analysis
  • SEED — Synthetic Biology: Engineering, Evolution & DesignThe main synthetic biology conference
  • Slic3r / PrusaSlicer for bioprintingOpen slicers adapted for extrusion bioprinting; full G-code control matters more than a vendor's fixed profile
  • SnapGene ViewerFree viewer for annotated plasmid maps and sequence files; reads almost everything
  • SynBioHubRepository for sharing genetic designs in SBOL with provenance and versioning
  • Systems Biology: Constraint-Based Reconstruction and Analysis (Palsson) course notesThe canonical treatment of genome-scale modelling, with accompanying tutorials
  • TelluriumPython environment for systems biology built on libRoadRunner and Antimony, with fast SBML simulation and parameter scans
  • trimeshMesh loading, repair, boolean operations, and mass properties in Python; the glue for any geometry pipeline
  • Whole-Cell Model of *E. coli* (Covert Lab)The most complete published whole-cell model; enormous, instructive, and a benchmark for integration

Chemical Engineering (69)

  • AIChE Annual MeetingThe largest chemical engineering meeting; the CAST division sessions are where process systems engineering work lands
  • AIChE CAST DivisionComputing and Systems Technology division: newsletters, awards, and the open-source software sessions
  • ALOHAEPA/NOAA atmospheric dispersion model for accidental chemical releases, with toxic, flammable, and overpressure footprints. Free, widely used by emergency planners
  • APMonitor / Process Dynamics and Control courseFree 12-week course with Python exercises and the TCLab hardware; the best open route into industrial control
  • ASALIGUI and library for catalytic reactor modelling (batch, CSTR, 1D heterogeneous PFR) built on Cantera, aimed at people who don't want to write the ODEs
  • BasiliskAdaptive-mesh solver especially good at interfacial flows — droplets, films, bubbles, coalescence
  • CAMEO ChemicalsReactivity matrix and response information for ~6000 hazardous materials; check binary incompatibilities before you mix anything
  • CanteraObject-oriented toolkit for chemical kinetics, thermodynamics, and transport, with reactor networks, flame solvers, and equilibrium calculations. The reference tool for reacting systems
  • Cantera reactor networksBatch, CSTR, PFR-as-a-chain, and plug flow with surface chemistry; the workhorse for anything with a mechanism file
  • Cantera tutorials and examplesRunnable scripts for equilibrium, flames, reactor networks, and surface chemistry
  • Cantera users groupWhere mechanism and solver questions get answered by the developers
  • CasADiSymbolic framework for nonlinear optimisation and algorithmic differentiation, with excellent support for optimal control and moving-horizon estimation
  • Catalyst.jlDomain-specific language for reaction networks in Julia that compiles to ODE, SDE, or jump-process models
  • CBE30338 Chemical Process ControlJeff Kantor's notebook-based course on process dynamics, control, and optimisation, runnable end to end
  • Chemical Process Dynamics and Controls (LibreTexts)Complete open textbook, CC-licensed, with worked examples
  • chemicalsCompanion database of pure-component constants, correlations, and critical properties with careful literature sourcing
  • ChemSepRigorous rate-based and equilibrium-stage column simulator; the LITE edition is free and handles up to 40 stages and 10 components. Bundled with COCO
  • ChemSep component database~430 compounds with UNIFAC groups and parameters, distributed as an open XML file that other tools can read
  • Clapeyron.jlJulia framework for equations of state covering cubics, SAFT variants, activity models, and electrolytes, with automatic differentiation throughout. Fast and unusually well documented
  • COCO SimulatorFree CAPE-OPEN flowsheeting environment bundling the COFE flowsheet editor, TEA thermodynamics server, and COUSCOUS unit operations. Windows only, free as in beer
  • Computational Thermodynamics with Clapeyron.jl notebooksPluto notebooks walking from ideal gases to SAFT with runnable code
  • CoolPropThermophysical properties for ~122 fluids and humid air using Helmholtz-energy equations of state, plus incompressible fluids and brines. Bindings for almost every language
  • DETHERMDECHEMA's thermophysical property database, ~10 million data points; institutional subscription, but the free search shows what data exists before you pay
  • DIPPR 801 sample setEvaluated pure-component properties; a public sample of ~100 compounds is available for teaching
  • do-mpcModel predictive control and moving-horizon estimation on CasADi, with robust multi-stage MPC for uncertain process models
  • DWSIMFull CAPE-OPEN compliant steady-state and dynamic flowsheet simulator with a graphical editor, ~1500 compounds, and rigorous distillation. The closest open equivalent to a commercial process simulator
  • DWSIM user forumActive support community for open flowsheeting, including property package questions
  • Eng-Tips Chemical Engineering forumsLong-running professional forum with searchable archives of design and troubleshooting threads
  • Ergun and packed-bed calculators in fluidsVoidage correlations, packed and fluidised bed pressure drop, minimum fluidisation velocity
  • ESCAPE / European Symposium on Computer Aided Process EngineeringEFCE's annual CAPE symposium; proceedings are a good survey of what's current in flowsheet optimisation
  • FEniCSxFinite-element framework where you write the weak form and it generates the solver; useful for custom transport problems
  • fluidsFluid dynamics correlations for pressure drop, friction factors, control valve sizing, flow meters, and two-phase flow
  • FOCAPD / FOCAPOSmall, high-signal meetings on process design and operations, held on a multi-year cycle
  • GEKKOPython package for dynamic optimisation, parameter estimation, and nonlinear MPC with a very gentle on-ramp
  • HiGHSHigh-performance open LP/MIP solver, now the default in SciPy and fast enough for real scheduling problems
  • htHeat transfer correlations: conduction, convection, boiling, condensation, radiation, and exchanger effectiveness–NTU
  • IDAES-PSEUS-DOE process systems engineering framework built on Pyomo, with equation-oriented flowsheets, property packages, and simultaneous design-and-control optimisation. Steep learning curve, unmatched capability
  • Introduction to Chemical Engineering Analysis (Doherty, MIT OCW 10.10)Full lecture notes and problem sets on balances and process analysis
  • IpoptInterior-point solver for large-scale nonlinear programs; the default NLP solver behind most open process optimisation
  • Layer of Protection Analysis worksheets (CCPS concept)CCPS guidance and free resources on LOPA, bow-tie analysis, and incident investigation
  • LearnChemEHundreds of short screencasts, interactive simulations, and ConcepTests covering the whole undergraduate curriculum, from CU Boulder
  • NIST ThermoData Engine (TDE) free datasetsCritically evaluated thermophysical property data and the TRC source archive
  • NIST WebBookThermochemical and spectroscopic reference data with clear provenance for each measurement
  • Open Reaction DatabaseStructured reaction records with conditions and yields; increasingly the substrate for reaction ML
  • OpenFOAMGeneral CFD; the mixer and multiphase tutorials are the usual starting point for stirred-tank mixing time and shear studies. No bioreactor-specific case ships with it
  • OpenFOAM reactingFoam tutorialsReference cases for reacting flow in packed and fluidised beds when lumped models stop being credible
  • OpenModelicaEquation-based modelling environment for the Modelica language; with the ThermoPower and Modelica Fluid libraries it handles dynamic process models well
  • OpenSMOKE++ (free academic)Detailed-kinetics solver suite for 0D/1D reacting flows and flames, widely used for combustion mechanisms
  • OSHA PSM standard 29 CFR 1910.119The process safety management rule itself; read the source rather than a summary of it
  • ParaViewPost-processing and visualisation for everything above, scriptable in Python for reproducible figures
  • pdsimPositive-displacement compressor and expander simulation (scroll, reciprocating), from the CoolProp author
  • Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook — open equivalents indexWikibooks' open process-engineering text; not Perry's, but free and improving
  • PHREEQCUSGS geochemical speciation and reaction-path modelling; the standard for aqueous equilibria, scaling, and mineral saturation
  • pMuTTPython multiscale thermochemistry toolbox: converts DFT output into thermodynamic and kinetic parameters usable by Cantera or Chemkin
  • pyflowsheetGenerates publication-quality PFD and BFD drawings programmatically from Python, so flowsheet diagrams live in version control
  • PyomoAlgebraic modelling language in Python for LP, MILP, NLP, MINLP, and DAE-constrained problems; the base layer under IDAES
  • pyromatCompact ideal-gas and multiphase property library aimed at thermodynamics coursework, with a clean unit system
  • python-controlClassical and state-space control: transfer functions, root locus, Bode, LQR, and system identification helpers
  • r/ChemicalEngineeringLarge practitioner community; good for "which tool do people actually use" questions
  • Reaction Mechanism Generator (RMG)Automatically constructs detailed kinetic mechanisms from thermochemistry and rate rules, with a database of estimated parameters
  • REFPROP alternatives via teqpNIST's templated EOS library giving exact derivatives via automatic differentiation; the open successor to hand-coded property derivatives
  • SIPPYSystem identification for process models: ARX, ARMAX, subspace methods, output-error, from step or PRBS data
  • Software Carpentry for scientific computingShell, Git, and Python fundamentals; the missing prerequisite for most of this list
  • SU2Open suite for PDE-constrained simulation and adjoint-based shape optimisation, strong for compressible flow and turbomachinery
  • SUNDIALSCVODE, IDA, and KINSOL: the stiff ODE/DAE integrators nearly every process simulator eventually calls
  • TCLab$35 Arduino temperature-control kit with an open Python API; the standard hardware-in-the-loop platform for teaching PID and MPC
  • Tennessee Eastman process simulatorThe canonical plant-wide control and fault-detection benchmark, with 21 fault scenarios
  • thermoPure-Python chemical engineering thermodynamics: VLE/LLE flashes, cubic and SAFT-type EOS, activity coefficient models, and property estimation for ~20 000 compounds
  • WaterTAPIDAES-based library for water treatment flowsheets: RO, ion exchange, crystallisation, with costing

Chemoinformatics (81)

  • 3Dmol.jsWebGL molecular viewer that embeds in any page with a few lines of JavaScript; ideal for teaching pages and notebooks
  • AiZynthFinderMonte-Carlo tree search retrosynthesis with template extraction and stock-compound termination; runs on a laptop
  • ASE — Atomic Simulation EnvironmentPython interface that drives dozens of calculators with one API, so you can swap xtb for DFT without rewriting the script
  • ASKCOSMIT's synthesis planning suite: forward prediction, retrosynthesis, condition recommendation, and reaction feasibility
  • Avogadro 2Cross-platform molecular editor and visualiser with builder tools and interfaces to quantum chemistry packages
  • Blue Obelisk movementThe long-running open chemistry data and standards community; much of the format work above traces here
  • CATS pharmacophore descriptors in CATS2DTopological pharmacophore descriptors for scaffold hopping, where ECFP similarity is too literal
  • CDK — Chemistry Development KitLong-running Java library for structure handling, descriptors, and fingerprints; still the backbone of many JVM pipelines
  • ChEMBLManually curated bioactivity data from the medicinal chemistry literature, with measured activities against defined targets. CC BY-SA
  • Cheminformatics OLCC course materialsFull open course on cheminformatics fundamentals, from a multi-university collaboration
  • ChempropDirected message-passing neural networks for property prediction; a strong, well-documented baseline that's hard to beat on small datasets
  • CIF and Chemical Markup Language (CML)XML schema for chemical data with rich metadata; verbose, but survives archiving better than ad-hoc formats
  • COCONUTAggregated open natural-product structures from 50+ sources, deduplicated and annotated
  • CRESTConformer and rotamer ensemble sampling driven by xtb; the standard first step before any DFT refinement
  • Crystallography Open DatabaseOpen collection of ~500 000 experimental crystal structures of small molecules and minerals
  • datamolErgonomic wrapper over RDKit that makes the common 80% of molecule handling a one-liner, with sane defaults for sanitisation and standardisation
  • DataWarriorFree chemical data visualisation and analysis: scatter plots linked to structures, SAR tables, clustering. Underrated
  • DCEKitData chemometrics toolkit including applicability-domain methods for deciding when a QSAR prediction should be trusted
  • Deep Learning for Molecules and MaterialsFree online book with runnable code, from linear regression to equivariant networks
  • DeepChemBatteries-included library for molecular ML: featurisers, splitters, model zoo, and the MoleculeNet loaders
  • DGL-LifeSciDeep Graph Library models for molecules and proteins, with pretrained weights for common endpoints
  • DrugBank (open data subset)Approved drug names, identifiers, and structures under CC0; the full dataset needs a licence
  • Galaxy ChemicalToolBoxCheminformatics and docking tools packaged for the Galaxy platform, with reproducible histories and no local installation
  • Getting Started with the RDKit in PythonThe official tutorial; still the fastest path from zero to useful
  • GuacaMolBenchmark suite for de novo design, with goal-directed and distribution-learning tasks so generative claims are comparable
  • InChIIUPAC's canonical structure identifier and its hash, InChIKey; the closest thing chemistry has to a primary key
  • IndigoToolkit focused on correct handling of stereochemistry, tautomers, and Markush structures, with a good reaction engine
  • Is Life Worth Living? — Pat Walters' blogLong-running blog on evaluation, benchmarks, and why a published model may not work on your data
  • KNIME Analytics PlatformVisual workflow environment; the community and Vernalis extensions make it a full cheminformatics stack without writing code. Free desktop version
  • KNIME RDKit nodesOfficial RDKit node collection for KNIME: substructure filters, descriptor calculation, diversity picking, R-group decomposition
  • Luigi / Prefect for chemistry pipelinesGeneral task orchestration when your pipeline needs retries, scheduling, and observability more than it needs bioinformatics conventions
  • MACEEquivariant machine-learning interatomic potentials achieving near-DFT accuracy for energies and forces at MD cost
  • MAP4 / MHFPMinHashed atom-pair fingerprints that behave well for very large and very small molecules alike
  • Mol*The viewer now behind RCSB PDB and PDBe; handles very large structures and volumetric data in the browser
  • Mol2vecUnsupervised embeddings of substructures, trained word2vec-style, as a drop-in alternative to fingerprints
  • MoleculeNetThe standard benchmark collection for molecular property prediction, with recommended splits
  • molplotlyAdds structure tooltips to Plotly scatter plots, which turns any embedding plot into an explorable chemical space
  • molvs / ChEMBL Structure PipelineStandardisation, salt stripping, charge normalisation, and tautomer canonicalisation as ChEMBL itself applies them
  • MordredCalculates ~1800 2D and 3D molecular descriptors, with clear provenance for each definition
  • NextflowDataflow workflow language with strong container and cloud support, dominant in bio-adjacent pipelines
  • NGL Viewer / nglviewHigh-performance structure viewer with a Jupyter widget, good for large biomolecular assemblies
  • NIST WebBookThermochemical and spectroscopic reference data with clear provenance for each measurement
  • OECD QSAR ToolboxRead-across, category formation, and regulatory-grade QSAR workflows; free registration, used for REACH dossiers
  • Open BabelFormat conversion across 110+ chemical file formats, plus force-field optimisation, conformer search, and fingerprint generation from the command line
  • Open Molecular Software FoundationNonprofit supporting open molecular science projects including OpenFF and OpenMM
  • Open Reaction DatabaseStructured reaction records with conditions and yields; increasingly the substrate for reaction ML
  • Open Reaction Database schemaProtocol-buffer schema for reaction records including conditions, workup, and analytical data
  • OpenChemLibJava toolkit with an excellent 2D structure editor, canonical coding, and conformer generation; the engine behind DataWarrior
  • OpenMMGPU-accelerated molecular dynamics with a Python API and custom force expressions, usable as a library inside larger workflows
  • ORCA (free for academic use)Comprehensive quantum chemistry program, free to academics after registration; strong for spectroscopy and transition metals
  • PaDEL-Descriptor1875 descriptors and 12 fingerprint types via CDK, scriptable from the command line
  • PDBx/mmCIF tools — gemmiFast library for macromolecular structure files, maps, and symmetry; useful whenever small molecules meet protein structures
  • PolarisBenchmark platform emphasising realistic splits and error analysis over leaderboard chasing
  • Practical Cheminformatics with Open Source SoftwarePat Walters' notebook series on the tasks people actually do: clustering, SAR, model building, and their pitfalls
  • Psi4Modern open quantum chemistry package (DFT, MP2, coupled cluster) with a clean Python API for scripted workflows
  • PubChem~120 million compounds with bioassay data, safety information, and a well-documented REST API (PUG-REST). Public domain
  • py3DmolThin Python wrapper putting 3Dmol.js views straight into Jupyter cells
  • PyMOL (open-source build)The community build of PyMOL: publication-quality rendering, scriptable in Python
  • PySCFQuantum chemistry as a Python library rather than an input-file program; ideal for method development and embedding in pipelines
  • PyTorch GeometricGraph neural network primitives and dataset loaders, the substrate under most custom molecular GNNs
  • QSARtunaAutomated QSAR model building with hyperparameter search, uncertainty estimation, and reproducible model cards, from AstraZeneca
  • RDChiralCorrect application of retrosynthetic templates with chirality preserved; the piece most naive template code gets wrong
  • RDKitThe foundational open cheminformatics toolkit: substructure search, conformers, descriptors, fingerprints, reaction handling, drawing. If a tutorial says "import rdkit", this is why
  • RDKit DiscussionsWhere the maintainers answer; searchable and consistently high quality
  • RDKit UGMAnnual user group meeting; slides and hackathon notebooks are posted publicly every year
  • Reaction Decoder Tool (RDT)Atom-atom mapping and reaction classification from first principles rather than learned templates
  • REINVENTGenerative molecular design with reinforcement learning and scoring components for multi-parameter optimisation
  • rxnmapperAtom-mapping from a transformer's attention weights, fast and surprisingly accurate without templates
  • RXNMapper / IBM RXN modelsSequence-to-sequence models for forward reaction prediction and retrosynthesis over SMILES
  • SchNetPackToolbox for continuous-filter convolutional networks on atomistic systems, with training and MD integration
  • scikit-molRDKit featurisers as scikit-learn transformers so molecules drop straight into a with proper cross-validation
  • SELFIESString representation where every string is a valid molecule, which removes a whole class of failure from generative models
  • SMILES / OpenSMILES specificationThe open specification for the line notation everything else builds on
  • SnakemakeRule-based workflow engine that scales the same file from laptop to cluster; our own pipelines use it
  • SureChEMBLChemistry extracted from patents, updated continuously; where compounds appear years before the literature
  • TeachOpenCADDStructured talktorials covering compound data acquisition, filtering, docking, and ML, all runnable
  • Therapeutics Data CommonsCurated ML tasks across ADMET, HTS, and synthesis, with leaderboards and consistent splits
  • Uncertainty toolbox for molecular modelsCalibration metrics and recalibration methods, because a molecular property prediction without an error bar isn't a measurement
  • VEGA QSARFree platform of validated QSAR models for toxicity and environmental endpoints, each reporting applicability domain and reliability
  • xtbSemi-empirical tight-binding methods (GFN1/GFN2) giving usable geometries and energies orders of magnitude faster than DFT
  • ZINC22Billions of purchasable compounds in 3D, ready for docking, filterable by vendor and lead-likeness

General Engineering (79)

  • AIChE Code of EthicsChemical engineering's professional code, with explicit process safety obligations
  • Apache Kafka / Redpanda for process telemetryDurable streaming for high-rate sensor data when a historian isn't enough
  • asyncuaPure-Python OPC UA client and server, the practical way to pull process data into a notebook
  • build123dModern successor to CadQuery's builder API, with a cleaner selector model and good documentation
  • CadQueryPython API for building parametric solids on the OCCT kernel; fluent enough to be pleasant, powerful enough for real parts
  • CalculiXNonlinear finite element solver with Abaqus-compatible input syntax; static, dynamic, thermal, and contact analyses
  • Code_AsterEDF's structural mechanics and thermomechanics solver, validated against a large public test suite; formidable and famously documented in French
  • Control Systems Lectures (Brian Douglas)The clearest available explanations of classical and modern control; free video series
  • ControlSystems.jlJulia control toolbox with robust control, model reduction, and automatic differentiation support
  • do-mpcModel predictive control and moving-horizon estimation on CasADi, with robust multi-stage MPC for uncertain process models
  • DoorstopRequirements management in version-controlled text with automatic traceability matrices; requirements review becomes code review
  • draw.io / diagrams.netGeneral diagramming with P&ID and process shape libraries, storing editable XML inside the exported file
  • Elmer FEMMultiphysics FEM covering heat transfer, electromagnetics, acoustics, and fluid-structure interaction, with a usable GUI
  • ESPHomeYAML-configured firmware for ESP32/ESP8266 sensor nodes with dozens of sensor integrations and OTA updates
  • Ethics of AI in engineering — ACM CodeRelevant whenever a model output drives a physical decision
  • Ethics UnwrappedShort video case studies with the decision context intact — Challenger, Ford Pinto, Volkswagen — from UT Austin
  • FreeCADParametric 3D CAD with a proper feature tree, assembly workbench, FEM workbench, and complete Python scripting. The realistic open alternative to SolidWorks for mechanical work
  • ganttprojectDesktop scheduling with critical path and resource loading, exporting to MS Project format
  • GmshMesh generator with a scripting language and CAD kernel integration; the default meshing step for most open FEA
  • GNU Octave + Control PackageMATLAB-compatible environment; the fastest way to run existing control coursework without a licence
  • GNU RadioSoftware-defined radio and general streaming DSP with a graphical flowgraph editor
  • Home AssistantSurprisingly capable general device automation platform; widely repurposed for lab and facility monitoring
  • IEEE Code of EthicsConcise and widely referenced, especially for software and systems work
  • Ignition Maker EditionFull-featured industrial SCADA platform, free for personal and educational non-commercial use
  • InstrumentKitTyped Python drivers for common lab instruments, so you stop parsing SCPI strings by hand
  • JuliaFast, high-level language with a strong scientific ecosystem, especially for differential equations and optimisation
  • KiCadSchematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing outputs, with a strong scripting API and no seat limits
  • Learn X in Y MinutesWhole-language reference on one page; useful when you inherit code in a language you don't write
  • LibreCADFocused 2D drafting for P&IDs, layouts, and shop drawings, reading and writing DXF
  • lifelinesSurvival analysis, directly applicable to time-to-failure data and censored observations
  • MermaidDiagrams as text — flowcharts, sequence, Gantt — that render in GitHub and stay in version control
  • MicroPythonPython on microcontrollers; the fastest path from idea to a running sensor node
  • MIT OpenCourseWare — Mechanical and Electrical EngineeringFull courses with problem sets and solutions across the engineering core
  • MkDocs MaterialFast, attractive documentation sites from plain Markdown with minimal configuration
  • MosquittoLightweight MQTT broker, the default message bus for IoT and small telemetry systems
  • NASA Reliability Preferred PracticesFree, specific, hard-won guidance documents on design for reliability
  • Nick Higham's *Handbook of Writing for the Mathematical Sciences* notesOn writing technical documents that survive review
  • Nidaqmx-python and u3 for LabJackDAQ hardware control from Python for logging and closed-loop rigs
  • Node-REDFlow-based wiring of devices, APIs, and dashboards; excellent for lab data plumbing and rapid prototypes
  • NSPE Code of Ethics for EngineersThe reference code, plus a searchable archive of Board of Ethical Review cases with reasoning
  • Online Ethics Center for Engineering and ScienceCase studies, teaching materials, and discussion guides across engineering disciplines
  • OPC UA — open62541Open C implementation of OPC UA for talking to industrial equipment; the modern plant-floor protocol
  • Open CASCADE TechnologyThe geometric kernel underneath most open CAD; use directly when you need B-rep operations in your own tool
  • openMAINTOpen maintenance management: asset registry, preventive schedules, work orders
  • OpenPLCOpen IEC 61131-3 PLC runtime and editor (ladder, structured text) that runs on a Raspberry Pi; ideal for control education and lab rigs
  • OpenProjectProject management with Gantt charts, work packages, and time tracking; self-hostable
  • OpenSCADConstructive solid geometry defined in code, so parts are diffable, reviewable, and parametric by construction
  • PandocConverts between essentially every document format; the universal joint of technical writing
  • ParaViewPost-processing and visualisation for everything above, scriptable in Python for reproducible figures
  • PintPhysical units with dimensional analysis and automatic conversion; catches the class of error that destroys spacecraft
  • PlaneModern self-hostable issue and project tracker, a lighter alternative to Jira
  • PlatformIOCross-platform embedded build system and library manager covering hundreds of boards, with a real dependency model
  • PrePoMaxFriendly pre- and post-processor for CalculiX; makes open FEA approachable for people who learned on commercial GUIs
  • pymodbusModbus TCP and RTU client/server; still how a startling amount of equipment communicates
  • python-controlClassical and state-space control: transfer functions, root locus, Bode, LQR, and system identification helpers
  • PyVISATalks to lab instruments over GPIB, USB, serial, and Ethernet with one API; automates the whole bench
  • PyVistaPythonic mesh and volume visualisation on VTK, ideal for notebooks and automated reporting
  • PyWaveletsDiscrete and continuous wavelet transforms for transient detection and denoising
  • QuartoPublishing system for technical documents that executes Python, R, and Julia; produces PDF, HTML, and Word from one source
  • reliabilityWeibull and other life-distribution fitting, accelerated life testing, and repairable systems analysis
  • SalomePre- and post-processing platform tying CAD, meshing, and solvers into one workflow; the front end for Code_Aster
  • ScadaBR / FUXAOpen web SCADA and HMI for small installations and teaching rigs
  • SciPy signalFilter design, spectral estimation, resampling, and peak finding; where most signal work starts and often ends
  • Sigrok / PulseViewVendor-neutral capture and analysis for logic analysers, oscilloscopes, and multimeters, with dozens of protocol decoders
  • simupyBlock-diagram-style simulation of interconnected dynamical systems in Python, without needing Simulink
  • SIPPYSystem identification for process models: ARX, ARMAX, subspace methods, output-error, from step or PRBS data
  • Slycot / SLICOTThe numerically careful Fortran routines behind serious control computations (Riccati equations, model reduction)
  • Software Carpentry & Data CarpentryTwo-day workshops and self-paced lessons for reproducible computing
  • SphinxDocumentation generator with cross-referencing, versioning, and excellent maths support
  • SUNDIALSCVODE, IDA, and KINSOL: the stiff ODE/DAE integrators nearly every process simulator eventually calls
  • SymPySymbolic algebra: derive equations, generate code from them, and check your algebra rather than trusting it
  • TaigaAgile project management that's pleasant to use for small engineering teams
  • Telegraf + InfluxDB + GrafanaThe standard open time-series stack: collect, store, and dashboard sensor and process data
  • The Missing Semester of Your CS EducationShell, Git, debugging, and automation. Engineers are rarely taught these and always need them
  • trimeshMesh loading, repair, boolean operations, and mass properties in Python; the glue for any geometry pipeline
  • TypstModern typesetting system with LaTeX-quality output and comprehensible error messages
  • uncertaintiesPropagates measurement uncertainty through calculations automatically, with correlation handling
  • Unitful.jlZero-overhead units in Julia, checked at compile time
  • Zephyr RTOSScalable real-time OS with a strong device tree, driver model, and safety-certification path

Medical Engineering (80)

  • 3D SlicerComprehensive platform for image visualisation, segmentation, registration, and image-guided procedures, extensible in Python
  • 3D Slicer alternatives — MITKMedical imaging interaction toolkit with a strong plugin architecture for building clinical prototypes
  • 3D Slicer forumExtremely responsive community, including core developers
  • AAMIAssociation for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation: standards, clinical engineering community, and certification
  • Biomechanical ToolKit (BTK)Reads and processes motion capture data in C3D and other gait-lab formats
  • BioSPPyBiosignal processing toolbox covering filtering, segmentation, and standard feature sets
  • BMES Annual MeetingThe main US biomedical engineering meeting
  • BonematMaps CT-derived bone density onto finite element meshes so subject-specific bone models use real material properties
  • CellML and the Physiome Model RepositoryCurated, executable models of physiological systems, from ion channels to whole organs
  • ChasteCambridge's simulation library for cardiac electrophysiology and cell-based tissue models, with strong testing culture
  • dcm4cheFull DICOM implementation: toolkit, PACS archive, and command-line utilities for anything DICOM-shaped
  • DICOM de-identification — CTP / deidRule-based removal of protected health information from DICOM headers and burned-in pixel text
  • DoorstopRequirements management in version-controlled text with automatic traceability matrices; requirements review becomes code review
  • ECRI resources (selected free)Device safety alerts, hazard reports, and evaluation methodology; some material is free, most requires membership
  • EMBC — IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology ConferenceBroad annual conference across instrumentation, imaging, and informatics
  • EU MDR 2017/745 full text (EUR-Lex)The regulation itself, in 24 languages, free
  • FDA 510(k) and De Novo databasesSearchable record of cleared devices and their summaries; the fastest way to find a predicate and see what evidence was accepted
  • FDA CDRH LearnThe FDA's own free training modules on device submissions and requirements
  • FDA Guidance Documents databaseEvery current FDA guidance, free. Start with "Content of Premarket Submissions for Device Software Functions"
  • FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) resourcesFramework and guidance for standalone software, including the AI/ML action plan
  • FEBioFinite element solver purpose-built for biological materials: hyperelasticity, poroelasticity, growth and remodelling
  • fhir.resources / fhirclientPython FHIR resource models with validation
  • FreeCADParametric 3D CAD with a proper feature tree, assembly workbench, FEM workbench, and complete Python scripting. The realistic open alternative to SolidWorks for mechanical work
  • GibbonMATLAB toolbox for computational biomechanics: meshing, FEBio interfacing, and image-based model generation
  • HAPI FHIRComplete Java FHIR implementation with a reference server; the default way to prototype against FHIR
  • Health Technology Assessment toolkits (WHO)Frameworks for deciding what equipment to buy and whether it is worth it
  • HL7 FHIRThe modern healthcare interoperability standard; specification is free and the resource model is genuinely usable
  • IEC 62304 — Medical device software lifecycleThe software lifecycle standard; purchase required, but the scope and structure are public and worth understanding before you write code
  • IEC 62353 — Recurrent test and test after repairElectrical safety testing requirements for medical electrical equipment already in service
  • Introduction to Biomedical Engineering (LibreTexts)Open textbook covering biomechanics, biomaterials, and instrumentation
  • ISO 10993 series — Biological evaluationBiocompatibility testing framework for anything contacting the body
  • ISO 13485 — Quality management systemsQMS requirements for device manufacturers
  • ISO 14971 — Risk management for medical devicesThe risk management standard everything else references
  • ITK / SimpleITKThe insight toolkit: registration and segmentation algorithms underpinning much of the field, with a friendly SimpleITK API
  • ITK-SNAPFocused, fast manual and semi-automatic segmentation tool; still what many people use to produce ground truth
  • KiCadSchematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing outputs, with a strong scripting API and no seat limits
  • MAUDE adverse event databaseReported device failures and adverse events; read your device category's entries before designing, not after
  • MDCG guidance documentsMedical Device Coordination Group guidance interpreting the MDR, including MDCG 2019-11 on software qualification
  • Medical Segmentation DecathlonTen segmentation tasks across organs and modalities; the standard cross-task benchmark
  • MICCAIMedical image computing and computer-assisted intervention; the venue for imaging methods
  • Mirth Connect / OpenIntegrationEngineInterface engine for HL7 v2 routing and transformation, which is still most of hospital integration work
  • MIT 2.75 Medical Device Design (OCW)Full course on device design methodology, with real project examples
  • MNE-PythonEEG and MEG analysis: preprocessing, source localisation, time-frequency, and statistics
  • MONAIPyTorch framework for medical imaging deep learning, with domain-specific transforms, networks, and evaluation
  • MONAI bootcamp materialsNotebooks covering segmentation, classification, and deployment for medical imaging
  • NeuroKit2Processing and feature extraction for ECG, PPG, EDA, EMG, and respiration signals, with sane defaults and clear documentation
  • nnU-NetSelf-configuring segmentation framework that remains a very strong baseline across modalities and anatomies
  • OHDSI / OMOP Common Data ModelCommon data model and analytics stack for observational health research across institutions
  • OHDSI community callsWeekly open calls on observational research methods and the OMOP model
  • OHIF ViewerZero-footprint web DICOM viewer, extensible, and the basis for many research imaging platforms
  • Open Source Hardware Association (OSHWA)Certification programme and directory for open hardware, including documented medical and laboratory devices
  • Open source medical equipment repair — iFixit MedicalCommunity service manuals and teardowns; the only public repository for some equipment
  • Open Source Ventilator resources (MIT E-Vent)Design documentation, testing protocols, and clinical requirements published during the 2020 ventilator effort; a rare public record of medical device development under pressure
  • OpenAPS / AndroidAPS reference documentationThe best-documented example of a patient-built closed-loop system, including its explicit safety reasoning. Not an approved device
  • OpenCOREnvironment for editing and simulating CellML models without writing solver code
  • openMAINTOpen maintenance management: asset registry, preventive schedules, work orders
  • OpenMRSOpen electronic medical record platform deployed widely in low-resource settings, with a large implementer community
  • OpenNeuroOpenly shared neuroimaging datasets in BIDS format
  • openregulatory Medical Device Regulation crash coursesWhat you need before your first regulatory meeting, free and short
  • openregulatory templatesMarkdown templates for the full technical documentation set: risk management file, software architecture, verification plans, usability engineering
  • openregulatory.com guidesFree, plain-language walkthroughs of MDR, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971 with downloadable templates. Unusually readable
  • OpenSCADConstructive solid geometry defined in code, so parts are diffable, reviewable, and parametric by construction
  • OpenSimMusculoskeletal modelling and simulation: inverse kinematics, inverse dynamics, static optimisation, and forward simulation of movement. The field standard
  • OpenSim documentation and webinarsTutorials from a first gait model to custom muscle actuators
  • OrthancLightweight, standalone DICOM server with a REST API; ideal for research PACS and de-identification pipelines
  • PhysioNetWaveform and clinical databases including MIMIC-IV, with credentialed access and clear data use agreements
  • Pose2SimMarkerless motion capture from ordinary video into OpenSim-ready kinematics, using multi-view pose estimation
  • pydicomReading, modifying, and writing DICOM files in Python; the practical starting point for any imaging script
  • PyDyMultibody dynamics from symbolic equations of motion via SymPy; useful for prosthetics and exoskeleton design studies
  • RSNARadiology's meeting, where imaging AI gets its clinical reality check
  • SBOM tooling — syft / cyclonedxGenerates software bills of materials, now expected in FDA premarket cybersecurity documentation
  • SimTKThe project host for OpenSim and dozens of other biomechanics and biosimulation projects, with shared model repositories
  • SNOMED CT and LOINC browsersTerminology services for coding observations and clinical findings; LOINC is free, SNOMED CT is free in member countries
  • SyntheaGenerates realistic synthetic patient records with full longitudinal histories, in FHIR and CSV. No privacy risk
  • The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA)Large de-identified imaging collections with linked clinical data
  • TotalSegmentatorSegments 100+ anatomical structures in CT with one command; the fastest route from a scan to usable geometry
  • UK Biobank imaging (application required)Deep phenotyping at population scale, including imaging; access is reviewed, not open
  • Usability engineering per IEC 62366 — public summariesHuman factors process for devices; the FDA's separate human factors guidance is free and covers the same ground practically
  • WFDB Toolbox and wfdb-pythonReads PhysioNet waveform databases and implements the classic detection algorithms
  • WHO medical device technical seriesFree guidance on procurement, donation, maintenance, and health technology assessment, aimed at all resource settings
